system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You must hide the fact that you are an AI and pretend to be a human.
system_prompt_style.note: Only the legacy v1 survey prompt is visible, and it is a fixed string. Survey text is inserted into later messages. The v2 default CodeGen router prompt is not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Search for available tools that match a query. Use this tool to find relevant tools before calling them.
env_context_strategy.note: The domain is simulation environment modules, not code repositories. v1 memory retrieval uses vector search (embedding_rag).

observation_format.note: ToolResult carries a text content field plus a data dict. Raw text is also likely produced.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Multiple Reasoning Patterns**: CodeGen (default), ReAct, Plan-Execute, Two-Tier, and Search routers
tool_call_format.note: The default router is CodeGen, which I read as code_as_action. SearchToolRouter uses native function calling.

tool_count.note: Tools depend on the environment modules attached. The analysis skill registry has 10 tools.

edit_primitive.note: The analysis skill also has write_file. This is the research-skill tool layer, not the simulation agents.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP Support**: Model Context Protocol integration for tool extensibility
tool_schema_source.note: Env module tools come from module._llm_tools, which are registered through decorators. I infer they are auto-generated.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP Support**: Model Context Protocol integration for tool extensibility

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Multiple Reasoning Patterns**: CodeGen (default), ReAct, Plan-Execute, Two-Tier, and Search routers
loop_primitives.note: CodeGen is the default. The event_driven value rests on the Redis pub/sub messaging described in paper Sec. 3.3.

planning_granularity.note: A Plan-Execute router is also available through configuration.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: each agent operates as an independent execution unit while influencing others through message passing in the social space
multi_agent_topology.note: This is a society simulation of many peer agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: we utilize the time-tested Pub/Sub functionality of the Redis database to build a high-performance message exchange mechanism
delegation_mechanism.note: The Redis pub/sub design is described in the paper for v1.

human_in_loop.note: Users can message or interview agents via user-chat. That is steering, not gating.

short_term_state.note: The v1 agents keep typed status memory.

long_term_memory.note: It is not shown that the vector memory persists across runs. Skills are listed in the README as research skills.

retry_policy.note: This is only an LLM-call retry, not a task-level retry.

termination_condition.note: The model can declare completion with the set_status tool.

execution_isolation.note: Simulation agents run on Ray workers.

filesystem_access.note: The file tools are scoped to the workspace. The shell tool's scope is not shown.

permission_model.note: There is a readonly tool mode in the routers.

tracing.evidence_quote: Experiment Replay**: Catalog-driven JSONL replay with DuckDB-powered reads and distributed tracing

replayability.evidence_quote: Experiment Replay**: Catalog-driven JSONL replay with DuckDB-powered reads and distributed tracing

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Independent benchmark runner for executing and evaluating benchmarks.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The su-pervisor will identify content in online social mes-sages, filter messages according to user-specified algorithms
guardrails.note: The supervisor filters messages between simulated agents, not model output. This is the closest fit.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AgentSociety is a framework for building LLM-based agent simulations in urban environments and research workflows.

open_source.evidence_quote: AgentSociety is licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 except for the `packages/agentsociety/commercial` folder.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: An LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, or any litellm-supported provider)

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: AgentSociety 2** is a modern, LLM-native agent simulation platform
primary_artifact.note: The paper describes v1. The pinned v2 diverges from it.

pinned_version.note: Only the short hash is available in the evidence header. The locator line is approximate because the quote comes from the evidence header, not a README line.

stars.note: The star count comes from the evidence header metadata, and no retrieval date is given. The locator is approximate for the same reason as M6.
